events.title: Pisgah Rage Pre-Season
events.description: Runs 15 Oct 2026 to 31 Dec 2026. Pre-season activities including social events, rider assessment, bike shop night, parent meeting, and adventure rides in Bent Creek or Dupont

events.title: Pisgah Rage Regular Season
events.description: Runs 1 Dec 2026 to 30 May 2027. NICA regular season with practices and races. Indoor training in January, weekend practices in February, multiple rides per week March-May. Races start beginning of March with 5-6 races across North Carolina through end of May. Racing occurs on Sundays with Saturday pre-rides.
